links.comparator_used: Original published calculator applied as-is to each hospital cohort (external validation without recalibration)
links.effect: c-statistic with original calculator 0.71 (BTH) and 0.61 (PFW) vs 0.84 and 0.74 after local recalibration; original cohort 0.80. Decision curve analysis showed net benefit of recalibrated calculators at average risk 0-3%.
links.tradeoff: Calculators need local recalibration for each context, which adds a per-site refitting burden.
links.quote: Refitting a pre-existing risk prediction model on our hospital cohorts showed improved model performance compared with using the original calculator as published.

links.comparator_used: Recalibrated model without the census tract-level Social Vulnerability Index (SVI) variable
links.outcome: Model fit (AIC) and incremental prognostic information for postpartum HDP readmission
links.effect: AIC 555 vs 523 at BTH and 1850 vs 1533 at PFW after adding SVI; SVI added 2.0% to 3.4% additional prognostic information at BTH and 36% to 50% at PFW.
links.quote: Our models' performances were slightly improved with the addition of the SVI variable.
